questions.stem: A 75-year-old woman has had a constant, dull pain in her back that has persisted for more than a month. She is in no acute distress. On physical examination, there are no abnormal findings. Laboratory findings include creatinine, 0.9 mg/dL; urea nitrogen, 17 mg/dL; total protein, 6.8 g/dL; albumin, 4.2 g/dL; total bilirubin, 0.8 mg/dL; AST, 25 U/L; ALT, 29 U/L; calcium, 10.8 mg/dL; phosphorus, 2.3 mg/dL; and alkaline phosphatase, 228 U/L. What is the most likely cause of hypercalcemia?
